title: Contemporary Seven-Bedroom Sea-View Pool Villa, Choeng Mon
blurb: A contemporary seven-bedroom villa set high above Choeng Mon on Koh Samui's north-east coast, commanding rare 180-degree panoramic views over the ocean and islands. Walls of glass and a large private pool open to the horizon, while the elevated, gated setting gives an exceptional sense of privacy. Some 1,388 m² of living space unfolds over multiple levels — seven en-suite bedrooms, a home cinema, billiard room, private gym, spa and sauna — a villa built as much for grand entertaining as for quiet retreat, on a 1,600 m² plot moments from the beach.
detail:
A SEA-VIEW LANDMARK ABOVE CHOENG MON
Set on an elevated 1,600 m² plot above the beach at Choeng Mon, in the quiet north-east corner of Koh Samui, this contemporary villa commands rare 180-degree panoramic views over the ocean and outlying islands — a genuinely unique outlook. Expansive sliding walls dissolve the boundary between inside and out, drawing the sea and sky deep into the interiors, while the architecture steps down the hillside to make the most of the sweep. The gated, elevated position affords a real sense of privacy and seclusion, yet it is only a short drive to Choeng Mon's beach restaurants, the Big Buddha and Fisherman's Village, with Samui International Airport around fifteen minutes away.

BUILT TO ENTERTAIN
Around 1,388 m² of living space is arranged over several levels. Open-plan living and dining rooms flow to wide terraces and a large private pool set on generous sun decks above the sea, framed by roughly 712 m² of landscaped gardens with mature planting, shaded lounging and a barbecue area. Multiple lounges, a fully fitted kitchen and a long dining table make it a natural party and entertaining house, while the scale and layout keep everyday living relaxed and private.

SEVEN SUITES & RESORT AMENITIES
Seven generous bedrooms each come as private en-suites with king beds, air-conditioning and their own televisions, many opening directly to the view. The villa is conceived for both relaxation and play: a home cinema and media room, a billiard room and bar, a private gym, a dedicated spa room and sauna, and a yoga space. Staff quarters support a fully serviced operation, and the property is secured behind a gated entrance with 24-hour security and CCTV, with private parking on site.

AN ESTABLISHED INCOME VILLA
Currently operating as a high-end luxury rental, the villa is offered fully furnished and turnkey, making it as compelling as an income-producing asset as it is a private residence. Offered at ฿150,000,000, available freehold or leasehold, with the furnishing schedule provided on request.
